remarks: Welcome to this move-in-ready ranch home on nearly an acre of land, offering country living a few minutes from downtown Wellsville. This home has 2 bedrooms, possibly a 3rd, and a full bath. Step inside to a functional entryway mudroom, perfectly sized to add custom hooks and baskets for all your daily outerwear and storage needs. The layout flows easily to the first bedroom, which is large, has a generous closet, and nice carpeting. Down the hall is a spacious living room with a modern double-sided gas fireplace. On the other side of the living room, the fireplace gives warmth and ambience to the dining room, creating the perfect setting for holiday gatherings. There’s also a large built-in shelving unit just waiting to showcase your personal decor. Next, the heart of the home, the bright, white, eat-in kitchen. A kitchen doorway leads you to a dedicated home office, a primary bedroom, and the full hall bathroom. Right off the kitchen is also a bonus room that could be the 3rd bedroom, another living room, or a yoga room. Outside, there’s a private front yard, great for sunny day lawn games. The backyard boasts a new covered deck, a spot for a firepit, and a grassy lot, just calling for raised gardens. Beneath the home, a 1-car garage has plenty of workspace. Unlock the hidden potential with the separate lower area. Situated next to the garage, this bonus space features a living room with a decorative stone fireplace, a kitchen area, a bedroom, a bonus room, and a roughed-in bathroom. It’s the perfect setup for a family member, guest apartment, or rental unit for passive income!
